text: Struggling with women? Today I'll give you five things you can start doing right now to turn that around. And trust me, this works whether you're starting from zero or just feel stuck. Number one, hit the gym or do some other sport. Not just for looks. It builds confidence, discipline, and teaches you about fitness and nutrition. Combine it with a wardrobe upgrade and your presence changes instantly. Number two, have your own life. A girl should never be your number one priority. She wants to join your adventure, not be the adventure. Fill your life with hobbies, goals, and friends. She should be part of it, not the center of it. Number three, set your standards. If she insults you or disrespects your boundaries, pull back. You don't need to explain. She knows. Disrespect isn't allowed. Number four, don't rush into a relationship. Most guys commit too quickly only to break up months later. See women, notice patterns, and commit only when you've truly found someone compatible. Number five, stay positive. Be a breath of fresh air, especially early on. Keep the vibe light and enjoyable. Bottom line, build yourself, keep your standards, and make her want to be a part of your world.
